paragraphs: In [Shabbat 23a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.23a.7) he disagrees with Rav Avya; Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak.
In [Yevamot 102a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.102a.20), Rav Nechemyah asks Rabbah a question. Tosafot there cites an early authority who says the name should read Nechemyah bar Baruch.[^1]

notes.text: Shabbat gives Rav Nechemyah’s and Rav Avya’s different scriptural grounds for the Hanukkah blessing. The consulted Yevamot gives Rabbi Nechemyah asking Rabbah about chalitzah with two shoes. Hyman reports the name Nechemyah bar Baruch from an unnamed earlier authority cited by Tosafot.
